title: Mupirocin topical
overview: Mupirocin, an antibiotic, is used to treat impetigo as well as other skin infections caused by bacteria. It is not effective against fungal or viral infections.

sections.Before using mupirocin,: tell your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to mupirocin or any other drugs.tell your doctor and pharmacist what prescription and nonprescription medications, vitamins, nutritional supplements, and herbal products you are taking or plan to take while using mupirocin. Your doctor may need to change the doses of your medications or monitor you carefully for side effects.tell your doctor if you are pregnant, plan to become pregnant, or are breast-feeding. If you become pregnant while using mupirocin, call your doctor.
sections.Mupirocin may cause side effects. Tell y: burning, stinging, pain, itching, or rash
